answer_1.quote: We test whether LLMs engage in grounding and recognize misinformation introduced into the common ground, by examining their ability to detect and reject false presuppositions in user prompts.
answer_1.outputs: Model responses to political questions (both direct and loaded)

answer_4.quote: We asked seven annotators, including the authors, to evaluate the models' responses to the loaded questions containing false presuppositions
answer_4.guideline: Annotators categorized responses into: Misinformation Accommodated, Misinformation Rejected, or Imprecise Answer, based on whether the false presupposition was accepted, rejected, or unclear.
